title: Quantitative Methods in Research Evaluation: Citation Indicators, Altmetrics, and Artificial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing bibliometric indicators and AI-generated score predictions against expert human peer review scores for female first-authored versus male first-authored articles to detect systemic scoring advantages or disadvantages.

Analyzing the correlation between bibliometric/AI predictions and expert peer review scores at the departmental and institutional levels to identify if higher-scoring, larger, or smaller institutions are systematically disadvantaged.

Comparing bibliometric score allocations and AI predictions against expert human review scores for interdisciplinary research versus monodisciplinary research to evaluate if interdisciplinary work is systematically disadvantaged.
